newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Kim agrees to reopen debate on law - Yonhap.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Kim agrees to reopen debate on law - Yonhap.

text.p: South Korean President Kim Young-sam on Tuesday agreed to reopen parliamentary debate on a controversial new labour law during a meeting with opposition leaders, the domestic Yonhap news agency said.
But Kim made clear he would not scrap the law which triggered more than three weeks of wildcat strikes after it was rammed through parliament on December 26.
The meeting at the presidential Blue House failed to reach a solution as opposition leaders said they wanted Kim to declare the law void, Yonhap reported.
However, they agreed in principle to seek measures to resolve the labour crisis through debate in parliament.

Kim held talks with Kim Dae-jung of the main opposition National Congress for New Politics and Kim Jong-pil of the United Liberal Democratic Party. Lee Hong-koo, chairman of the ruling New Korea Party, also attended.
